t: The GP Ultra+ lithium CR123A/CR2 battery provides long-lasting energy for high-tech devices. Able to withstand temperatures between -40 to +60°C, with a shelf life of up to 10 years when stored in a cool and dry place away from direct sunlight. Whether its a smart door lock, camera, camera flash, handheld torch, or motion sensor, GP Ultra+ ensures consistent and reliable performance.
b: Shelf Life of Up to 10 Years
